bandcampDescription: Specialized in indie artists. Limited amount of tags
beatportDescription: Overall more specialized in Techno, can match using ISRC
beatsourceDescription: Overall more specialized in open-format (Hip Hop/Latin/Dancehall)
bpmsupremeDescription: Specialized in chart & open-format. Requires a free account
deezerDescription: Spotify alternative, but faster. No login required
discogsDescription: Slow due to rate limits (~25 tracks / min) & requires a free account
itunesDescription: Slow due to rate limits (~20 tracks / min)
junodownloadDescription: Overall a mixed bag with a lot of niche genres
musixmatchDescription: Fetch lyrics from the largest lyrics platform in the world
spotifyDescription: Requires a free account, can match using ISRC
beatportMaxPagesTooltip: How many pages of search results to scan for tracks
deezerContentLanguageTooltip: Enter a locale to use with Deezer API
discogsTokenTooltip: To obtain a token, create a free account on Discogs. For more information, click Help on the right.
discogsMaxAlbumsTooltip: How many albums in search results to check. Due to rate limiting this increases tagging time by a lot
discogsTrackNumberIntLabel: Write track number as number, rather than Discogs's format
